Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 9, 2026

Welcome to the privacy policy of Wrist Power. We value your privacy and want to be clear about how the game works.

1. Information We Collect

Wrist Power does not require you to create a personal account and does not ask for your name, email address, or other direct personal information.

The game uses Firebase Anonymous Authentication to create a random anonymous identifier for gameplay features.

2. Data Stored in Firebase

We use Firebase to store game-related data such as scores, progress, and basic gameplay records so your game experience can be saved and restored.

This data is associated only with your anonymous Firebase identifier and is not used to identify you personally.

3. How We Use the Data

The data stored in Firebase is used only to:

- save scores and progress

- restore gameplay data across sessions

- keep the game functioning properly

4. What We Do Not Do

We do not sell your data, and we do not use the information stored by the game for advertising, profiling, or unrelated analytics.

We do not collect contacts, photos, microphone data, location data, or payment information through the game.

5. Third-Party Services

Wrist Power uses Firebase, a service provided by Google, to support anonymous login and data storage. Firebase may process technical information according to Google's privacy practices.

6. Data Retention

Game data stored in Firebase is kept for as long as necessary to provide the service or until it is deleted according to our maintenance or data removal policies.

7. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

8. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: me@zbd.com.tr

By using Wrist Power, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
